_comment: Moderation's rights, shipped as a library layer (composition D4, M9). They name only the
'Moderation' pseudo-type this library reserves, and only its own slots, which the application
An unbound slot refuses startup. The per-type grants (Vote/Question, Lock/Answer, ...) cannot ship
here: the application owns its types, so --spark-init-moderation still prints those for it to paste.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "moderation": false }.
